Because you deserve it Several temporary contracts Chance to earn your SVS Cleaning Certificate (we’ll help you get it!) Training & growth opportunities, move up to Supervisor or Team Leader if that’s your vibe *Hourly wage applies from age 20+ Jouw baan Join a friendly and international team at Hilton Garden Inn Leiden and help create an exceptional guest experience. As a Housekeeping Attendant, you'll ensure our hotel rooms are clean, comfortable, and welcoming for every guest. Your responsibilities: Clean and service guest rooms to Hilton standards Change linens and make beds Clean bathrooms and replenish guest amenities Maintain a fresh, tidy, and welcoming environment Your attention to detail helps guests feel at home from the moment they enter their room. Working hours: Weekdays: 09:00 – 15:00 Weekends: 10:30 – 17:00 Additional hours available during busy periods and peak seasons. EW Facility Services EW Facility Services has been a trusted provider of cleaning and facility services in the Netherlands for over 30 years. With more than 3,000 colleagues, we support hotels, hospitals, offices, and other organizations by creating clean, safe, and welcoming environments every day. For this position, you will work at Hilton Garden Inn Leiden, a modern hotel conveniently located near Naturalis Biodiversity Center and Leiden city centre. You'll be part of an international hospitality environment, working alongside a diverse and supportive team committed to delivering an excellent guest experience. Jij bent We're looking for reliable and motivated team members who take pride in creating a great experience for hotel guests. You: Live in or near

Leiden Speak English and/or Dutch Have an eye for detail and work independently Are flexible and available to work at least 2 weekends per month Previous housekeeping or cleaning experience is a plus, but not required Whether you're experienced in housekeeping or looking for a new opportunity, we'd love to hear from you! Solliciteren Apply today and become part of the housekeeping team at Hilton Garden Inn Leiden. Together, we'll ensure every guest enjoys a clean, comfortable, and memorable stay.
